pages.text: Small scripts by mantikafasi. Use $(l)wget <url> <name>$() on a computer, or copy from the page.
$(l)fly$(): flight on a neural interface with Plethora's sensor, scanner and kinetic modules. Replace $(l)mantikafasi$() in the script with your own name.
$(l)uncorrupted_library$(): redstone output on the left while a Dank below holds over 1024 of every demon crystal type it contains.
